title.en: Start here: the classic hard problems
title.zh: 从这里开始：常考的难题

description.en: The calculations every part of the course practises that neither the sample questions nor the practice exam ask, one problem for each, and how to set out a calculation for full marks.
description.zh: 课程各部分都练过、而样题和模拟卷都没考到的计算题，每类一道例题，以及计算题怎样写才拿满分。

title.en: The problems, one of each kind

text.en: The review lectures' sample questions and the practice exam leave out several calculations that the lecture slides work through, and that textbook exercises on this material ask again and again. Each has a lesson here, built around one problem written in the style of the exam.
text.zh: 复习课的样题和模拟卷，漏掉了好几类课件里专门演算过、教材习题里也反复出现的计算。这里每类一课，每课围绕一道仿照考试风格写的题。

rows.en: The frame sent for data 10011101 with generator $x^3 + 1$, and whether a flipped bit is caught.
rows.zh: 数据 10011101、生成多项式 $x^3 + 1$ 时发出的帧，以及翻转一位能否被发现。

rows.en: The codeword for 1101, and which bit of 1010111 is wrong.
rows.zh: 1101 的码字，以及 1010111 错在哪一位。

rows.en: CSMA/CD at 1 Gbps over 1 km: the shortest frame that still detects collisions.
rows.zh: 1 Gbps、1 公里的 CSMA/CD：还能检测到冲突的最短帧。

rows.en: A 4000-byte datagram through an MTU of 1500: lengths, offsets, MF flags.
rows.zh: 4000 字节的数据报经过 MTU 1500 的链路：长度、偏移、MF 标志。

rows.en: Address blocks for four organisations from 198.16.0.0; four /21s aggregated.
rows.zh: 从 198.16.0.0 起给四个机构分地址块；把四个 /21 聚合。

rows.en: The shortest path from A to D in an eight-router network.
rows.zh: 一个八台路由器的网络里，A 到 D 的最短路径。

rows.en: Stop-and-wait and a window of 7 over a satellite; the window and sequence numbers that fill it.
rows.zh: 卫星链路上的停等协议和 7 帧窗口；填满链路要多大的窗口、几位序号。

rows.en: Keys, encryption and a signature with p = 3, q = 11; a shared key with n = 23, g = 5.
rows.zh: p = 3、q = 11 时的密钥、加密和签名；n = 23、g = 5 时的共享密钥。

text.en: The problems are written for this course; their numbers come from the lecture slides' own examples or from standard textbook exercises.
text.zh: 这些题是为本课程写的；数字取自课件里的例子，或标准教材的习题。

title.en: How to set out a calculation

items.en: **Name the rule** before using it: *the frame must last at least $2\tau$*; *a /s block starts at a multiple of its size*.
items.zh: **先写规则**再用它：*帧的持续时间至少要 $2\tau$*；*/s 的块必须从它大小的整数倍开始*。

items.en: **One step per line**, with the numbers put in and the units kept: µs, bits, bytes.
items.zh: **一行一步**，代入数字，带上单位：µs、位、字节。

items.en: **Say what the result means**: *so the minimum frame is 1250 bytes*; *so bit 6 is wrong*.
items.zh: **说清结果的意思**：*所以最小帧长是 1250 字节*；*所以第 6 位错了*。

items.en: **Check it** when a check is cheap: divide the CRC frame again; decrypt what you encrypted.
items.zh: **能验算就验算**，只要不费事：把 CRC 的帧再除一遍；把加密的结果再解密回来。

text.en: Each lesson works like the exam units: the problem as printed and a slow read of it; the ideas it needs, from the ground up; the working, one line at a time, with one line left to you; the answer written out for full marks; the wider topic; and new problems.
text.zh: 每一课的走法和前两个单元一样：题目原文，慢慢读一遍；从头讲需要的想法；一行一行写出过程，留一行给你；按满分标准写出答案；这类题的全貌；再做几道新题。

body.en: Every full-mark answer is in English, so you can write in the words the examiner expects.
body.zh: 满分答案都用英文写，方便你直接用阅卷人熟悉的词作答。
